name: Arms Trafficking and Illicit Firearms
description: Illicit supply and diversion of firearms, ammunition and components, including straw purchases, illegal manufacturing, end-user certificate fraud and brokering outside licence. Financial indicators arise in dealer payments, shipping, brokers and cash purchases.

sources.text: UN Protocol against the Illicit Manufacturing of and Trafficking in Firearms (2001)
UNODC, Global Study on Firearms Trafficking 2020 (2020)
SIPRI, Trends in International Arms Transfers (annual fact sheet)

exposure.rationale: Dealer and broker payments, trade documentation and shipping for transfers, plus cash and straw purchases by individuals; arms dealers are regulated non-bank businesses.
